items.title: iv) Inter-particle space in solids (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: iv) Inter-particle space in solids: a main subheading of 5.11 General properties of solids, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 109-109.

blocks.text: Solids mein particles ke darmiyan jagah liquids se bohat kam hai, kyunke un ki forces zyada mazboot hain. Qareeb qareeb bhare atoms, molecules aur ions ki wajah se solids aam taur par sakht hote hain, un ke melting points oonche hote hain aur woh bohat stable (mustahkam) hote hain.
